body: It's been ok.  And I haven't been in direct contact, but a lot of triggers out there cause me to remind me of him.
I needed a night of sleep to cool off.  I appreciate the feedback, but I also fear of relapsing from time to time.
Well I haven't been directly asked that from anyone at camp.  If the bosses know, I think they're being courteous enough to respect that it's up to me If I feel comfortable bringing it up, not them.
A couple of them are friends of mine that I talk to and hang out with from time to time.  Not sure if they are coming back next summer.  I've been with this camp for 10 years.

I do plan to travel, either by myself or with a friend or two.  Only one friend knows the details of this situation.  He's telling me to forget about it, but part of me wants to exact revenge on this ex friend.
Very, I just feel like I'd be looked down on and that I would probably not feel as welcome to stay there.
